operators.name: unfold_forward
semantics: Performs the same operation as nn.Unfold with given kernel_size=(3,5), dilation=1, padding=(1,2), stride=1.

Input is a 4D tensor (N, C, H, W) = (16, 3, 512, 512); output is (N, C*prod(kernel_size), L) where L = floor((H + 2*pad_h - dilation[0]*(kernel_h-1)-1)/stride +1) * floor((W + 2*pad_w - dilation[1]*(kernel_w-1)-1)/stride +1).
Kernel parameters (kernel_size, dilation, padding, stride) are passed as integer pairs (tuples), but represented as int64_t in C++ binding.
The output is on CUDA and float32, matching reference checkpoint step_001.

operators.name: cat_forward
semantics: Concatenates tensor_a and tensor_b along dimension dim=1, matching torch.cat((x, x), dim=1).
Since tensor_a and tensor_b are identical slices of the same tensor, this duplicates the input along channel dimension.
Returns a new tensor with shape [16, 90, 262144], preserving dtype and device.
Applies nn.Unfold operation with kernel_size=(3,5), dilation=1, padding=(1,2), stride=1 on input [16,3,512,512].
Output shape [16,45,262144]; each output row corresponds to a sliding window block flattened in C x kernel_h x kernel_w order.
The operation preserves float32 dtype and runs on CUDA, as shown in checkpoint.
Concatenates the unfolded tensor with itself along channel dim 1, resulting in [16,90,262144].
The second argument is the same tensor, so the result is an exact duplication along dimension 1.
Output dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride matches reference.
This is the final forward output.
